topics.topic: `read_spooled_file` behavior when request digest/size/media_type disagree with stored SpooledFile metadata (refuse vs ignore)
questions: When `read_spooled_file` receives digest/size/media_type that do not match the SpooledFile record found by lookup identity, must the call be refused or are those fields ignored?
If the caller supplies digest/size/media_type that do not match the stored SpooledFile record, should the operation refuse, or ignore those descriptive fields?

quotes:
`read_spooled_file` takes only a SpooledFile — never a StoredValue — and names
it by its identity — `run_id`,
`producer_node_id`, `map_index` (omitted for a node that is not mapped),
`attempt_number`, `producer_port`, `list_index` (omitted for a `one`
port) — the lookup identity; its digest, size and media type only describe it

The identity of a StoredValue M21, or of a SpooledFile M22 (`run_id`,
`producer_node_id`, `map_index`, `attempt_number`, `producer_port`,
`list_index`); `store` resolves where the bytes are.
judgement.why: The text explicitly says lookup uses only the identity fields and that digest/size/media_type are descriptive, so mismatches in those descriptive fields do not affect lookup.

topics.topic: For bindings with no output ports, whether response bodies must still be size-checked or can be ignored regardless of size
questions: For a binding with no output ports, must the response body still be size-checked (and fail if over ceiling), or can it be fully ignored regardless of size?

topics.topic: How file-input bytes are sourced and passed into `service_invoker.prepare_request` for operation nodes
questions: When an operation node has file inputs, who provides the file bytes to `prepare_request` and by what argument shape: does `runs` pass bytes into `effects.reach_operation_element`, or does `effects` load bytes itself (for example via `store.read_value_bytes`) from file identities?

topics.topic: Paging order position for mutable records: fixed at creation or moved on each update
questions: For mutable records (notably Run M19, approvals, grants), what is the store position used for paging order: creation position only, or does each update move ordering position?

topics.topic: Whether `get_repair_view` continuation tokens are bound to original request identity/args and refusal on mismatched reuse
questions: Is the `get_repair_view` continuation token bound to the original slot identity (and other request arguments), and what refusal applies when a token is reused with a different slot request?

topics.topic: Whether `list_records` run `status` filter uses stored `Run.status` or computed status from `runs.read_run`
questions: Does `status` filtering for runs apply to stored `Run.status` (used by `store.page_records`) or to the computed status from `runs.read_run`?

topics.topic: Whether selected instance name is an explicit `prepare_request` input or inferred from M10 fields for pre-send error classification
questions: Is selected instance name an explicit input to `prepare_request`, or must it infer `instance_not_selected` vs `instance_address_missing` only from absent/present M10 fields?

topics.topic: `list_records` handling of filter sets containing nonexistent record IDs: existence-checked vs treated as raw values
questions: For set filters containing a mix of existing and nonexistent record IDs, is existence checked explicitly, or are all values treated as raw field values with no existence lookup?

topics.topic: `read_spooled_file` refusal type for structurally malformed file identity shape
questions: If `read_spooled_file` is called with a structurally wrong identity shape (for example `map_index` present for a non-mapped node, or wrong `list_index` presence), must it return `refused` (malformed element naming) or `unknown_reference` (no matching SpooledFile)?
